experiment: E7b — unbiased re-test of story matching: MiniLM vs OpenAI text-embedding-3-small@512 (free, stored vectors)
why: E7's 200 labelled pairs were selected with MiniLM (its similarity band and its clusters), so they cannot rank MiniLM against another model. E7's MiniLM-vs-OpenAI conclusion is withdrawn; this test replaces it.
design: Pooled evaluation with equal depth (the standard way to compare retrieval systems without favouring one). 1) 40 anchor articles drawn uniformly at random (seed 2026) from the 7-day story window (canonical articles with both vectors) — no model involved. 2) For each anchor, the 4 most similar articles from OTHER outlets within the 72 h clustering window, by each model's time-aware similarity (the similarity 2.3 clusters on). 3) The pool = the union of both models' candidates. 4) Every pooled pair is labelled same story / different story, blind: pairs shuffled, no model names, no scores. Labeller: Claude (the maintainer may spot-check).
label_definition: Same story = both articles report the same specific event or development (A02), not merely the same topic.

metrics.M1_retrieval: Per model: precision@1 and @4 (share of its candidates that are same-story), and recall@4 = its same-story candidates / all same-story pairs in the pool. 95 % intervals by bootstrap over anchors (2,000 resamples).
metrics.M2_clustering: Per model, on the pooled pairs: precision and recall of 2.3's cluster co-membership at its threshold (MiniLM 0.60; OpenAI over the sweep 0.30–0.80).
metrics.M3_threshold_free: AUC of each model's similarity on the pooled pairs.

decision: The maintainer chose OpenAI @512 (A56). Its story threshold = the threshold with the highest F1 on the pooled pairs among those with precision ≥ 0.90. MiniLM is reported for comparison only.
limitations_known_in_advance: Recall is relative to the pool: a same-story pair neither model ranks in its top 4 is not counted. 40 anchors give wide intervals. Labels by Claude.
rules: No change to anchors, depth or label definition after seeing results. No claims; method findings may go to FINDINGS.md.
